## Cleveland-Cliffs Awarded 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. was named a 2025 GM Supplier of the Year by General Motors at its 34th annual
Supplier of the Year event. Cleveland-Cliffs was the only North American steel producer recognized
this year. This is the ninth time the company has received the award.

[ View Press Release ][47]

## Congressional Steel Caucus Hearing

Lourenco Goncalves, Cliffs Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer and the Board Chairman of
the American Iron and Steel Institute provided testimony at the Congressional Steel Caucus held on
January 14, 2026.  Mr. Goncalves spoke about the importance of maintaining Section 232 steel tariffs
and fair trade for the steel industry in the United States. 

The Congressional Steel Caucus is a bipartisan group of U.S. Representatives and Senators working to
support the American steel industry, its workers, and its vital role in national security and
infrastructure, advocating through legislation, meetings with officials, and challenging unfair
trade practices.

Read Mr. Goncalves' testimony, [click here][48]

[ Watch Steel Caucus Hearing on YouTube ][49]

## Cleveland-Cliffs Announces POSCO as MoU Counterparty

Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. is pleased to announce that POSCO, Korea’s largest steelmaker and the world’s
third largest steelmaker outside of China, is its strategic partner under the previously disclosed
transformative Memorandum of Understanding. The MoU between the two companies was executed on
September 17, 2025. With the recent completion of the new U.S. and Korea trade agreement,
cooperation between the two nations’ industrial sectors will be further reinforced by the
POSCO-Cliffs partnership.

Read more in the complete News Release.

[ Read News Release ][50]

## Steel Tariffs

The United States’ steel tariffs continue to play a vital role in supporting the long-term strength,
stability, and competitiveness of the domestic steel industry. In 2025, President Trump restored the
effectiveness of steel Section 232 tariffs by increasing the tariff rate from 25% to 50%, completely
eliminating exclusions and exemptions that had drastically weakened the measures and adding Section
232 tariff coverage of certain steel  derivative products. Trade measures such as Section 232
tariffs are essential to countering persistent global steel overcapacity and unfair trade practices
that distort markets and undermine U.S. producers. These tariff measures help ensure that America
maintains a reliable domestic steel supply critical to sustain U.S. national security.

There are early indications of positive impact, including moderated import pressure and improved
conditions for domestic production. Full year 2025 finished steel imports were down 17% vs. 2024.
However, the full benefits of these tariffs will take time to be fully realized. Steelmaking is a
capital-intensive, long-cycle industry, and meaningful gains in capacity utilization, reinvestment,
and workforce development occur gradually.

## CNBC Invest in America Forum

Lourenco Goncalves, Cleveland-Cliffs Chairman, President & CEO participated at the CNBC Invest in
America Forum. Moderated by Sara Eisen, CNBC Anchor, the panel discussion was about fostering
economic growth and innovation, revitalizing the consumer and supply chains. Joining Lourenco was
Ana Botin, Santander Executive Chairman and John Furner, Walmart U.S. President. To view the panel
discussion, view the video below.

[ Watch Panel Discussion ][51]

##### **The New Frontier Of Growth**

# Sustainable.
# Intentional.
# Transformational.

### Driving Change

BIOEDGE™ is redefining what’s possible in sustainable steel. Through EAF technology, circular
manufacturing, cutting-edge innovation, and sustainably sourced materials, we’re helping industries
decarbonize.
[Learn More][90]

##### What we do

We are a leading industrial metals solutions company. We operate using a circular manufacturing
model, producing lower-carbon-emission, quality products with recycled scrap as the primary input.
We are one of the largest domestic steel producers and metal recyclers in North America, combined
with a meaningful downstream steel fabrication platform. The company is also currently investing in
aluminum operations to further diversify its product offerings. Our circular economy is driven by
the passion and dedication of our innovative teams at each of our operating platforms: steel, steel
fabrication, metals recycling, and aluminum.

[LEARN ABOUT OUR CIRCULAR MANUFACTURING MODEL][91]
Recent News
Recent Presentations

## Steel Operations

Our steel operations produce steel products, including hot roll, cold roll, and coated sheet steel,
structural steel beams and shapes, rail, engineered special-bar-quality steel, cold finished steel,
merchant bar products, and specialty steel sections. These operations primarily consist of our seven
EAF steel mills and numerous value-added coating operations with approximately 16 million tons of
steel shipping capability.

[Learn About Our Steel Operations][92]

## Steel Fabrication

Our steel fabrication operations produce structural steel joist and deck building systems. Our steel
fabrication operations have a national operating footprint that allows us to serve the entire
domestic construction market, as well as national accounts.

[Learn About Our Steel Fabrication][93]

## Metals Recycling

Our metals recycling operations collect and process ferrous and nonferrous scrap from manufacturing
and end-of-life items, such as automobiles, appliances, and machinery. This processed scrap is then
sold to end-users for reuse, including our EAF steel mills. Our metals recycling operations are
strategically located primarily in close proximity to our steel mills and other end-user scrap
consumers, throughout the United States, and Central and Northern Mexico.

[Learn About Our Metals Recycling][94]

# Sustainable.
# Intentional.
# Transformational.

### Driving Change

BIOEDGE™ is redefining what’s possible in sustainable steel. Through EAF technology, circular
manufacturing, cutting-edge innovation, and sustainably sourced materials, we’re helping industries
decarbonize.
[Learn More][90]

##### What we do

We are a leading industrial metals solutions company. We operate using a circular manufacturing
model, producing lower-carbon-emission, quality products with recycled scrap as the primary input.
We are one of the largest domestic steel producers and metal recyclers in North America, combined
with a meaningful downstream steel fabrication platform. The company is also currently investing in
aluminum operations to further diversify its product offerings. Our circular economy is driven by
the passion and dedication of our innovative teams at each of our operating platforms: steel, steel
fabrication, metals recycling, and aluminum.

[LEARN ABOUT OUR CIRCULAR MANUFACTURING MODEL][91]

Recent Presentations

## Steel Operations

Our steel operations produce steel products, including hot roll, cold roll, and coated sheet steel,
structural steel beams and shapes, rail, engineered special-bar-quality steel, cold finished steel,
merchant bar products, and specialty steel sections. These operations primarily consist of our seven
EAF steel mills and numerous value-added coating operations with approximately 16 million tons of
steel shipping capability.

[Learn About Our Steel Operations][92]

## Steel Fabrication

Our steel fabrication operations produce structural steel joist and deck building systems. Our steel
fabrication operations have a national operating footprint that allows us to serve the entire
domestic construction market, as well as national accounts.

[Learn About Our Steel Fabrication][93]

## Metals Recycling

Our metals recycling operations collect and process ferrous and nonferrous scrap from manufacturing
and end-of-life items, such as automobiles, appliances, and machinery. This processed scrap is then
sold to end-users for reuse, including our EAF steel mills. Our metals recycling operations are
strategically located primarily in close proximity to our steel mills and other end-user scrap
consumers, throughout the United States, and Central and Northern Mexico.

[Learn About Our Metals Recycling][94]

supplying premium products around the world. We also have an international network of regional sales
teams, so our global customers receive local service. Our commitment to innovation and
sustainability ensures we remain at the forefront of the steel industry.

## In a rapidly **changing world**

On site, we have 4 decoiling lines, 5 roll-formers, 2 wide coil slitters and 1 narrow coil slitter
alongside a host of supporting processes.
Our customer service and commercial team will guide you through the process of selecting product,
setting visual standards, and providing support that extends far beyond the supply of the material;
this includes access to our long experience of quality control and quality assurance, backed up with
**ISO 9001** and **ISO 14001 accreditation** and enhanced further with strong sustainability
credentials.

ABOUT US

Chuzhou Jincheng Metalwork Co.,Ltd,was established in 2007,which is a independent management
manufacturer of exporting scaffolding products.Covering an area of about 102,000 square meters,
there are two factories, the new factory contains galvanized workshop, with employee of more
than500.Professional R & D,production and sales of steel scaffolding and aluminum scaffolding
products, monthly export quantity of more than 600 containers.
We’re a key export-earning enterprise in China.Products are exported to Europe, North America,
Oceania, Southeast Asia and other regions. Our company has gradually improved the after-sales
service system to provide customers with the most convenient after-sales service.
We have passed the ISO9001:2015 quality system certification, EN3834-2 welding quality system
certification, EN1090-2/3 steel and aluminum structure welding quality system certification.
Moreover in line with the EN12811, EN12810, AS1576, AS1577 standard issued by the German TUV
certification authority. And also have reached a number of test standards for scaffolding products
in the EU,such as loading, and welding penetration.

Our equipment can meet the production of all kinds of scaffolding products. The full automatic
production capacity of most products has been realized with advanced and complete automatic
production equipment. Meanwhile, galvanizing equipment have been invested, and the surface treatment
galvanizing of all products will be operated by ourselves. In 2017, the R&D center was established,
and 5 invention patents and 14 utility patents were obtained. 13 invention patents have been
authorized, and the new products and molds involved are independently developed and produced by
ourselves, thus solved the difficult situation of new product development.

Driven by innovation, MESCO STEEL continues to expand into new materials and application fields,
working closely with partners to promote efficient, safe, and sustainable development in
construction and industry. Choosing MESCO STEEL means choosing professionalism, efficiency, and
reliability.

# **Custom-Engineered Steel Building Manufacturer**

Nucor Building Systems has been a leader in the design and manufacture of custom-engineered metal
building systems for over three decades. With four strategic plant locations and a coast-to-coast
network of over 1,400 Authorized Builders, we efficiently service customers throughout North America
and beyond. Our metal buildings are fully customized to fit our customer’s unique needs to provide
sophisticated, energy efficient, and environmentally friendly building solutions.  See for yourself
how a metal building can work for you.

[Custom Manufacturing Pre-Engineered Building]

## What Type of Building Do You Need?

As a fully custom steel building manufacturer, your possibilities are endless. Using the latest in
design technology, your metal building will be custom engineered to achieve the optimal solution for
you.

[I NEED A BUILDING][42]

[Add insulation to your roof with R-Boost]

## Increase Roof Insulation with R-Boost

Want an economical solution that helps you achieve increased levels of thermal performance, and meet
increasingly stringent energy codes? R-Boost, Nucor’s new elevated roof insulation system, is your
solution.

[MORE ABOUT R-BOOST][43]

[Metal Building with Insulated Metal Panel Exterior]

## **Insulated Metal Panels** by Metl-Span

An excellent option for nearly any type of building, insulated metal panels by our sister company,
Metl-Span, work seamlessly with metal buildings to offer an economical, energy efficient,
sustainable solution.

## Decarbonizing at scale

We're done with dirty.

Cleaning up heavy industry, which is responsible for 40% of all global CO₂ emissions, is key for
tackling the climate crisis. The steel industry alone accounts for more than 7% of the world's CO₂
emissions.

We're on track to produce near-zero emission steel.

[Discover our steel][33]

## It all begins in Boden

Get ready for a fully integrated, digitalized, and circular plant in Boden, northern Sweden. Our
giga-scale electrolyzer, powered by renewable electricity, will be the largest green hydrogen
production plant in Europe. By swapping coal for green hydrogen, we refine iron ore into green iron,
emitting steam – just plain water. This is game-changing innovation making it possible for us to
produce near-zero emission steel, setting a new industry standard. When fully operational, we will
reduce steel emissions by over 7 million tonnes per year. Europe's first new steel mill in 50 years
is on its way.

[Read more][34]

## Hey you! Wanna fight carbon emissions?

Join us in cleaning up the world’s dirtiest industries.

[Check our career page][35]

## Decarbonizing at scale

We're done with dirty.

Cleaning up heavy industry, which is responsible for 40% of all global CO₂ emissions, is key for
tackling the climate crisis. The steel industry alone accounts for more than 7% of the world's CO₂
emissions.

We're on track to produce near-zero emission steel.

[Discover our steel][33]

## It all begins in Boden

Get ready for a fully integrated, digitalized, and circular plant in Boden, northern Sweden. Our
giga-scale electrolyzer, powered by renewable electricity, will be the largest green hydrogen
production plant in Europe. By swapping coal for green hydrogen, we refine iron ore into green iron,
emitting steam – just plain water. This is game-changing innovation making it possible for us to
produce near-zero emission steel, setting a new industry standard. When fully operational, we will
reduce steel emissions by over 7 million tonnes per year. Europe's first new steel mill in 50 years
is on its way.

[Read more][34]

## Hey you! Wanna fight carbon emissions?

Join us in cleaning up the world’s dirtiest industries.

[Check our career page][35]

### Why Telegram?

### Simple

**Telegram** is so simple you already know how to use it.

### Private

**Telegram** messages are heavily encrypted and can self-destruct.

### Synced

**Telegram** lets you access your chats from multiple devices.

### Fast

**Telegram** delivers messages faster than any other application.

### Powerful

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

### Open

**Telegram** has an open [API][40] and source code free for everyone.

### Secure

**Telegram** keeps your messages safe from hacker attacks.

### Social

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

### Expressive

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

##### Telegram

Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with a focus on security and speed.

## tk accelis signs 10-year strategic agreement with SKF to strengthen steel supply chain across
## France and the UK

tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions has signed a new 10-year long-term agreement with SKF for the
supply of steel bar products across France and the United Kingdom. Under the agreement, tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions will manage the supply of steel bar materials supporting SKF's manufacturing
operations, delivering secure, reliable and efficient material availability through an integrated
supply chain approach.

The contract forms part of tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions' Global Control Tower offering, a
comprehensive, technology-enabled solution that combines strategic materials sourcing, supply chain
management, logistics, inventory optimization and digital visibility. Designed to help manufacturers
navigate increasingly complex global supply chains, the Global Control Tower provides end-to-end
transparency, predictive planning and proactive risk management while supporting the availability of
materials where and when customers need them.

By integrating materials supply with advanced supply chain management capabilities, tk accelis
Supply Chain Solutions will support SKF in enhancing operational resilience, improving inventory
performance and increasing supply chain efficiency across its operations in France and the UK.

François Pillavoine, Chief Sales Officer at tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions France, said:

"This long-term agreement demonstrates the trust SKF has placed in tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions
as a strategic supply chain partner. We look forward to continuing our partnership with SKF over the
next decade and supporting their long-term manufacturing ambitions."

Ivan Bourgeois, Aerospace Purchasing Manager Europe at SKF, added:

"This long-term agreement with tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions represents an important step in
supporting our continued growth across France and the UK. Having a trusted partner with deep
materials expertise and a resilient global supply network enables us to enhance operational
efficiency, improve supply continuity and respond with greater agility to evolving market demands.”

The agreement reflects the growing demand for strategic partnerships that extend beyond traditional
materials distribution, enabling manufacturers to build more agile, data-driven and resilient supply
chains capable of responding to changing market conditions.

## tk accelis awarded five-year Airbus A220 material supply contract from Dynamatic Technologies

tk accelis Supply Chain Solutions has been awarded a five-year contract by Dynamatic Technologies
Limited (DTL) in India to support the Airbus Atlantic A220 program’s all door package, which
includes the supply and manufacture of all major aircraft doors. Under the terms of the contract, tk
accelis Supply Chain Solutions will provide comprehensive supply chain management services for
Dynamatic Technologies and its network of machined parts suppliers in India.

The scope of the project includes demand forecast management, inventory management, supplier
management, and value-added processing solutions designed to enhance operational efficiency and
program performance.

The contract marks a significant milestone in the relationship between the two companies and
reinforces their shared commitment to strengthening India’s aerospace manufacturing and supply chain
ecosystem. Building on an already established partnership, the agreement further expands
collaboration efforts between the two companies, which also includes supporting production across a
range of global aerospace platforms, including Airbus, Boeing, Deutsche Aircraft, Bell and Lockheed
Martin programs.

“This contract is a testament to the trust, collaboration and shared vision that we have built with
Dynamatic Technologies over many years,” said Gopi Hanumanthappa, Managing Director at tk accelis

Certified grades, traceable mill documentation, and precision processing — available from regional
stock programs worldwide.

Flat Products

### Flat Steel — Hot & Cold Rolled

Hot-rolled, cold-rolled, galvanized, and organic-coated steel strip for structural panels, cladding
systems, and precision components. Available in standard grades and customer-specific dimensions.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][12]
[structural steel sections — beams columns and hollow sections]
Long Steel

### Structural Sections & Beams

Universal beams, columns, HSS/SHS/RHS hollow sections, angles, and channels. CE-marked structural
steel meeting EN 10025-2 S235/S275/S355 grades with full third-party inspection documentation.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][13]
[stainless steel and specialty alloy products]
Specialty Alloys

### Stainless Steel & Alloys

304/316 austenitic, duplex 2205, nickel alloys, aluminium plate, and copper & brass strip.
Corrosion-critical environments demand material documentation — we provide EN 10204 3.1 certificates
as standard.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][14]
[thyssenkrupp MRL elevator system interior design]
Vertical Transport

### Elevator Systems

Machine-room-less traction elevators, hydraulic lifts, stair lifts, and cab interior design. From
new installations to full modernization — engineered for reliability, safety certification, and 25+
year service life.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][15]
[steel processing — plasma cutting and CNC fabrication]
Processing

### Steel Processing Services

Precision slitting to ±0.1mm, plasma and laser cutting to ±0.5mm, CNC press braking (up to 1,000t),
hot-dip galvanizing, and surface treatment. Reduce your supply chain steps and lead time.

[Request Specs & Pricing →][16]
Documentation

### Mill Certificates & Technical Data

EN 10204 3.1 material test reports, third-party inspection certificates, chemical and mechanical
property data — available digitally within 24 hours of order confirmation.

[Request Documentation][17]

Green Steel Initiative

## Decarbonizing Heavy Industry — One Heat at a Time

thyssenkrupp's direct reduction hydrogen steelmaking program — currently in industrial-scale
commissioning at the Duisburg site — targets a 30% reduction in CO₂ intensity per tonne of crude
steel by 2030, advancing toward carbon-neutral operations by 2045.
* Hydrogen-based direct reduction replacing blast furnace operations
* 100% renewable electricity procurement for processing centers
* ISO 14001:2015 environmental management certification across all sites
* Scope 3 emissions reporting for supply chain transparency

Tianjin Yinfeng Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

Founded in 1988, Tianjin yinfengzhizao Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. has subsidiaries and
business units in Australia, Singapore, and Bulgaria. Its main products include rebar truss
production lines, rebar mesh welding machines, CNC rebar stirrup bending machines, rebar cage
production lines, rebar bending machines, various intelligent manufacturing production lines,
industrial robots, MES systems, digital twin technologies, and smart factory management systems.
Tianjin yinfengzhizao is a collaborative supplier to China Construction, China Railway Group, China
Communications Construction Company, China Power Construction Corporation, and other leading
enterprises. Its products are exported to over 100 overseas projects, including those in Russia and
Argentina. Major customers include China Construction Technology’s factories in Shenzhen, Huzhou,

Tianjin Yinfeng Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

Founded in 1988, Tianjin yinfengzhizao Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. has subsidiaries and
business units in Australia, Singapore, and Bulgaria. Its main products include rebar truss
production lines, rebar mesh welding machines, CNC rebar stirrup bending machines, rebar cage
production lines, rebar bending machines, various intelligent manufacturing production lines,
industrial robots, MES systems, digital twin technologies, and smart factory management systems.
Tianjin yinfengzhizao is a collaborative supplier to China Construction, China Railway Group, China
Communications Construction Company, China Power Construction Corporation, and other leading
enterprises. Its products are exported to over 100 overseas projects, including those in Russia and
Argentina. Major customers include China Construction Technology’s factories in Shenzhen, Huzhou,
Guiyang, and others; SANY Construction Machinery; Dalian Zhengda; Beijing Construction Engineering;
Shanghai Construction Engineering; China Construction Third Bureau in Wuhan; Chongqing CCCC
Prefabricated Construction; Guangdong Zhit; Hainan Weite; Hebei Xindadi; Dezhou Haitian; Hong Kong
Huaxie; Taiwan Peibo Steel; Taiwan Quanyi; Russia’s DSK and SU555; the Moscow–Saint Petersburg
high-speed rail project and BTS-Most; Uzbekistan’s BTB; India’s EEE; Saudi Arabia’s NEOM New City;
Belgrade Metro Line 1 in Serbia; Macedonia’s KARPOS; Bulgaria’s Reinforcement Company; and
Argentina’s Santa Cruz Hydropower Station, among others. The flexible welded wire mesh machine with
infinitely adjustable longitudinal bar spacing, developed by Tianjin yinfengzhizao, has solved the
longstanding challenge of manually tying rebar mesh in the construction industry. It can produce
more than 400 different specifications of composite slabs and wall panel meshes daily, saving over
40 workers previously engaged in rebar drawing, processing, tying, and inspection. This innovation
was awarded the “Customer-Favorite New Equipment Award” at the 2023 China Concrete Exhibition’s

and Hebei University of Technology, stands as a landmark textbook in the rebar processing industry,
serving as a valuable reference for technical and managerial personnel when selecting equipment.

## La Lettre [Vernimmen.net][67]

Tous les mois depuis 2001, elle apporte à ses 55 000 abonnés un article de réflexion sur l’actualité
financière, un graphique ou un tableau statistique utile dans leur pratique de la finance, une revue
d’un travail de recherche et une question avec sa réponse.

[[Pictogramme j’aime Facebook.]][68]

## Réseaux sociaux

Régulièrement nous commentons l’actualité financière, postons l’une questions à laquelle nous avons
répondu, donnons une nouvelle ou une citation. Devenez nos amis !

[[Pictogramme livre Pierre Vernimmen Finance d’entreprise.]][69]

## Le Vernimmen 2026

Découvrez les principales caractéristiques du Vernimmen 2026, le livre de finance d’entreprise de
référence pour les professionnels et les étudiants depuis 1974, avec plus de 200 000 exemplaires
vendus.

[[Pictogramme micro podcast.]][70]

### 16-03-2026 :
### Amazon ou la leçon d'endettement

Mardi 10 mars 2026, Amazon a levé 37 Md$ sur le marché obligataire, puis 14,5 Md€ le lendemain.
C’est autant que le précédent record de la plus grosse émission obligataire réalisée par une
entreprise (Verizon, 49 Md$ en 2013), réalisée pour financer une acquisition.

Ici, le but du financement n’est pas la croissance externe, mais le financement des investissements
qui enflent quasi exponentiellement :

11 Md$ en 2019

31 Md$ en 2020

47 Md$ en 2021

72 Md$ en 2024

114 Md$ en 2025

Et 200 Md$ annoncés en 2026, à cause de l’IA et des data centers bien sûr.

Et pourtant, Amazon était toujours en situation d’endettement net négatif fin 2025 : 105 Md$ de
liquidités pour 87 Md€ de dettes bancair # [Vernimmen.net][1]

### Safety and health

The steel industry is committed to the goal of achieving an injury-free and healthy workplace for
all employees and contractors.

[More Safety and health ][23]

### Climate action

Our industry fully supports the aims of the Paris Agreement. We are committed to a low-carbon
future.

[More Climate action ][24]

### Wider sustainability

The steel industry is committed to transparent data disclosure and continual improvement in
environmental performance issues, including water use, air quality, and maximising resource use.

[More Wider sustainability ][25]

[Our people]

### Our people

The success of the steel industry is intrinsically linked to its diverse people. Education and
training for a net-zero future is a priority.

[More Our people ][26]

### Steel is everywhere

Steel is the most commonly used metal in the world. It is everywhere in our lives.

[More Steel is everywhere ][27]

### [June 2026 crude steel production ][31]

World crude steel production for the 70 countries reporting to worldsteel was 155.7 million tonnes
(Mt) in June 2026, a 1.7% increase compared to June 2025.

[][32]
[steeluniversity][33]
15 July 2026

### [steelChallenge-21 | Regional Championship][34]

The Regional Championship returns on 17 November 2026. Participants will have 24 hours to complete a
steelmaking simulation, and for the first time, high school students can take part. Registration
opens on 1 September.

10 July 2026

### [steelManagement-27 registration open | Bangkok | 29 Nov-4 Dec ][37]

steel industry professionals develop the leadership skills needed for the next stage of their
careers.

key industries. This is a member-only report.

Engineers from Carnegie Mellon University in the U.S. have developed pioneering stainless steel
neural probes that could make brain research and treatment much safer and more effective.

World crude steel production for the 70 countries reporting to worldsteel was 157.9 million tonnes
(Mt) in May 2026, a 0.3% decrease compared to May 2025.

### [3D printed steel connectors set to make the construction industry more sustainable][53]

Researchers at the University of Aberdeen in Scotland are creating 3D-printed, reusable steel
connectors that will make buildings easier to reuse, adapt and recycle, reducing demolition.

color coating lines and one writing board production line. The annual output is more than 620,000

services, such as cutting, slitting, profiling, punching, bending, etc.

### About Us

#### More than a company, Wanzhi Steel aims to be your trusted steel solution provider and business
#### partner.

Wanzhi Steel, established in 2011, is a leading manufacturer and supplier of diverse steel products
in China. Our main products include hot/cold rolled steel, galvanized steel, galvalume steel, ZAM
steel, pre-painted steel and stainless steel in coil, strip, sheet and plate and so on.

We have two galvanizing lines, one galvalume and ZAM (aluminum-magnesium-zinc) coating line, three
color coating lines and one writing board production line. The annual output is more than 620,000
tons. Except for various steel products, we also have advanced equipment to offer further processing
services, such as cutting, slitting, profiling, punching, bending, etc.
